_provenance.source: agy 1.5.16 and 1.5.18 (linux-x64, each the release the vendor's update manifest served that day), installed into isolated prefixes and run in a bwrap sandbox whose OS home was a tmpfs, with a scratch HOME and AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true. Each Drive-shaped run used the adapter's own argv (`--output-format=stream-json --input-format=stream-json`) plus the mode under test. On 2026-11-24 there was no sign-in and stdin was closed; on 2026-11-27 the owner signed in to the scratch home through agy's own sign-in, the runs sent one prompt each, and the sign-in was then deleted for the `signedOut` run.
_provenance.note: Each string is ONE line copied verbatim from the run's stdout, stderr or agy's own run log (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/log/cli-<stamp>.log` in the scratch home). Scrubbed: in `signedIn.init`, `conversation_id` -> `<conversation>` and `init.cwd` (a scratch workspace path) -> `<workspace>`. Nothing else was changed. Lines carrying the account email, the sign-in URL, conversation ids or capture paths were not taken.

signedIn._note: Signed in (2026-11-27), one prompt per run asking for a workspace file write and a shell command. `args` are the mode arguments, passed after `--output-format=stream-json --input-format=stream-json`. `reached` is the mode the run's own evidence shows: its run-log mode lines, and whether the write landed and the command ran or was soft-denied. Every line is from 1.5.16. 1.5.18 ran noMode, settingsDefault, settingsDefaultModeAuto, modeDefault and settingsAuto with the same stderr, mode lines (timestamps aside) and outcome, plus settingsAuto on a resumed conversation (`settingsAuto1_5_18`); it did not run accept-edits or plan.
